presentation.title: SOLUTIONS FOR REMOTE OPERATIONS
presentation.subtitle: INFRASTRUCTURE + SERVICES + OPERATION
presentation.text: BASE 4.200 is a specialized business unit of OBEMA focused on developing and integrating solutions for remote camps and operations. We integrate infrastructure, services, and specialized suppliers to tailor solutions to the conditions and requirements of each project.
presentation.subtext: A single integrator to articulate accommodation, services, and operational support.
presentation.infra_desc: High-habitability modular units and heavy-duty tents engineered to withstand extreme winds and thermal amplitudes.
presentation.services_desc: High-quality nutritional catering, uninterrupted power supply, and logistics management under a single command.

solutions.title: WHAT WE OFFER
solutions.subtitle: A comprehensive solution for camp development and operations.
solutions.p1_desc: Modular units and high-altitude heavy-duty tents built for extreme weather.
solutions.p2_desc: Balanced nutrition, dietary control, and strict cold-chain compliance.
solutions.p3_desc: Comprehensive maintenance and sanitation of living quarters, dining, and work zones.
solutions.support_subtitle: Services and infrastructure integrated according to the specific needs of each operation.
solutions.closing: A SINGLE SOLUTION. CONFIGURED FOR EVERY OPERATION.
solutions.closing_subtext: We dimension and coordinate all components under a unified standard.
